title: Creation of Ravenscroft Asylum
text: The Ravenscroft Asylum is founded by Count Silas Ravencroft in Crescent Keep, overlooking the town of Crescent Hills.

title: Construction of Castle Hemmeth Begins
text: The visionary architect Norex Volcron begins the massive architectural undertaking of building the castle of King Hemmeth I.

title: Construction of Castle Hemmeth Finished
text: Norex Volcron completes the construction of Castle Hemmeth, plunging the country into massive debt to the Volcron family.

title: Castlefall & Fall of Hemmeth Empire
text: King Hemmeth I's Castle is mysteriously swallowed by unknown forces, killing the king and collapsing his empire.

title: The Fire of Crescent Keep
text: Crescent Keep is entirely destroyed by a catastrophic fire. King Hammeth II, Count Silas Ravencroft, and all staff and patients perish.

title: Collapse of the Hemmeth Succession
text: Following the sudden death of King Hemmeth II without a clear heir to the throne, the historic Hemmeth Empire officially collapses, plunging the entire country into a dark period of deep political unrest and instability, leading to a civil war.

title: Independence of Crescent Hills
text: Following the sudden collapse of the Hemmeth Empire, the town of Crescent Hills gains unique autonomous independence.

title: Creation of the Anchor Corporation
text: The Anchor Corporation is founded, quickly establishing a shipping powerhouse and seizing control of the Harbour District.

title: Coronation of King Alexander Algar
text: King Alexander Algar 'the Immortal' is officially crowned, shifting the political alignments of the kingdom, and ending the long civil war.

title: Siege of Crescent Hills
text: King Alexander conducts a successful military siege of Crescent Hills, forcefully absorbing the prosperous city into the new Algaros kingdom.

title: The Burial of Nikoleta Crowe
text: Nikoleta Angela Crowe is buried at the age of 18. Her family publicly claims that she is deceased.

title: Arrival of Laughingmen Entertainment
text: Laughingmen Entertainment makes its dramatic debut in Crescent Hills, building an expansive presence outside town borders.

title: Reappearance of Nikoleta Crowe
text: Nikoleta Crowe dramatically resurfaces as the bright and joyful co-owner of Laughingmen Entertainment, despite family claims of her death.

title: Creation of the People's Church
text: Arthur Marrow spearheads the People's Church of the Perfect Body, gathering rapid following inside the city.

title: The Burning of Carsteen Street
text: The city guard sets fire to the church chapel on Carsteen Street under smuggling allegations, burning down a massive portion of uptown.

title: The Murder of Mayor Zachery Marigold
text: Mayor Zachery Marigold of Eagle's Hope mysteriously dies after receiving a prophetic warning message from Evan Glass.

title: The Tower (Session 0)
text: On the eve of the anniversary, time stops via the Sandwalker effect. A group of anomalies meets Evan Glass and destroys the clocktower, tearing the ground open.

title: The Black Cloak Perimeter
text: The Order of the Black Cloak swoops into the farmlands of Eagle's Hope, setting up heavily armed perimeter checkpoints to contain the abyss.

title: The Chariot (Session 1)
text: The anomalies descend into the newly formed chasm, braving Volcron infrastructure, automated trains, and organic horrors to rescue Tyler the Flesh Harp.

title: Royal Commendation for Dr. Thalia Veil
text: King Alexander's Council formally decides to honor Black Cloak agent Dr. Thalia Veil, issuing a prestigious reward for her exceptional bravery and medical expertise demonstrated during the subterranean rescue of Tyler the Harp.

title: A Fire in the Hills (Session 1)
text: A mysterious man in a fedora rots the farmlands, sparking a devastating fire in the Hill District. Amidst city-wide chaos and looting, a newly formed crew clashes over a house robbery, gets arrested, and cuts a deal with investigator Medio Gato.

title: The Heist of Crescent Keep (Session 2)
text: The crew resolves their legal issues via lawyer Elixis before tracking Dave the Mushroom to the junkyard. After executing two rat-kin informants and Dave himself, they infiltrate the Laughingmen Circus under a false inspector guise—discovering that the entertainment empire has secretly purchased the ruins of Crescent Keep just as the real, faceless Inspector arrives.

title: Operation Judgement (Session 2)
text: The expedition team advances into the copper restaurant layers of the castle. Head Forgemaster Roghar is discovered assassinated under suspicious gas line manipulation. The party recovers links to Fierre Laughingman before an ambush by the automaton 'Mstar Sun' claims the lives of Ninos and Dr. Thalia Veil.

title: Black Cloak Expedition Lockdown
text: Following the tragic deaths of Ninos and Dr. Thalia Veil during Operation Judgement, the Black Cloak Order issues an immediate lockdown on all exploration under or in Eagle's Hope. Both Operation Empress and Operation Star are placed on hold indefinitely, and all external contract members are ordered to remain at their current surface stations under threat of immediate termination.

title: The Adventurers Take Action
text:
With the city of Eagle's Hope being closed off for exploration and documentation, and with winter incoming, the Order of the Black Cloak has made it known that they will most likely terminate the contracts of outside operators permanently, if no solution to the current safety hazard can be found.

To make matters worse, Doctor Jane Ursa has made it known that the Sandwalker effect, the same effect that is freezing the city in time, is spreading. A few meters each month, and seemingly increasing in speed. With a few calculations done, it might only be a matter of months before the entire region is frozen in time.

All of this has been going on in the later days of November 1089, and you have not been sitting idly by waiting for instructions. You have been sending messages to various benefactors and nobles, asking for their aid in negotiation of your contract. Additionally you have been sending messages from your encampment to the Academy in Red Tail seeking out knowledge. Both of these ventures are going well!

From the most unlikely sources, help can be found. In this case, from the ocean kingdom of Tritos, ruled by the Triton Kingdom. Prince Erythros Triton, son of king Caspian, is willing to meet you and see what the possibilities are for creating an independent organisation that works with the Order. This would give you freedom to plan your own excursions, but still enjoy the resources of the order. You can meet him in Peregrine to get this moving faster.

Meanwhile from Red Tail, a message has been received by its Collector of History, Lady Rayna ( Daughter of RayRay the Zoooligist ). She claims she has found concrete information about what the castle under Eagle’s Hope is, and why and how it was buried. She is eager to share this information if you were to meet her in the Graveseal Academy in Red Tail.

title: Start of the Hemmeth Conquest
text: The grand campaign to unite the divided territories under a single banner begins. This historic expansion marks the initial rise of the Hemmeth dynasty as they aggressively conquer neighboring houses and regions.

title: The Kraken Rebellion
text: The aquatic factions and citizens of the deep launch a massive, coordinated rebellion against the brutal reign of the tyrant Kraken King in the shallow sea.

title: Founding of Tritos
text: Following a successful campaign of peaceful persuasion after the fall of the Kraken King, House Triton successfully claims the sunken throne, officially establishing the independent oceanic kingdom of Tritos at the bottom of the shallow sea.

title: The Fall of Argo Navis
text: The golden space city of Argo Navis, floating on the edge of the world's atmosphere, catastrophically collapses and plummets from the sky, leaving behind shattered celestial ruins and bringing a tragic end to the advanced era of the Astrolux Star People.

title: The Exochon Doom
text: A swift and devastating doom comes for the Exochon race after they seek out to harness forbidden, cosmic chaos powers. As punishment for their hubris, the entire race is placed under a permanent curse where all mothers die in childbirth; because no new Exochons can join this world unless born as rare twins, every subsequent death permanently lowers their global population by one.

title: The Hermit: Part 1 (Session 3)
text:
Bippo the Hippo and Alice the reporter went out to the city of peregrine to meet up with tthe younger prince of Tritos, Erythros. before the meeting with the prince however, the 2 had a chance encounter with one of the last remaining exochon's, Julia Heliotrop. Due to charms and oppertunities, the exochon decided to become the guide of the 2 adventurers in the city.

When they ended up in a magic shop, they innitially wanted to purchase healing potions, but ended uup walking away with something way more valuable insead: a starcore originating from the ruins of Argo Navis.

bippo had a vision when in the presence of the star, likely a memory of some sort, and thus he was th one who kept the star.

Now various sources tell me that after the whole ordeal, bippo brought the star home and had another clearer vision, about the lost empire of Jolera and one of the more dangerous individuals currently roaming the world, Youri Emerald.

after leaving the shop, they found the prince in the Apollo hotel, where terms and conditons for funding a new adventuring guild were laid out. In the end, the following happened: The Wonderless Timing Guild was astablished by Erythros as guildmaster, and Julia H. as guildkeeper. The guild grounds would be located as well outside of Eagle's Hope, and would feature 5 buildings to start:

The Wonderless Guild hotel, where guild members can freely claim an apperment that they can decorate during their stay. It is a large brass and sandstone hotel featuring a giant clocktower

next is the guildhall, where the offices of julia and Erythros  are located, aswell as the mess hall, and locker rooms for adventuring. the archives are there aswell.

Following that is Alice's Forge, where equipment can be crafted and mended with the resources found in the castle.

The research center is where the labs and and liberary are located, as well as julia's second office

lastly there is the all you can eat restraunt, run by Bippo the hippo, called Hungry Hippo's, with a large hippo face at the front.

In order to secure the documents and reports that we could sp freely demand from the black cloaks, i made a deal with our friend alice, where i buy her mission reports and send them to you.

i think these new situations could be very ppositive for us. it might help us gather more information and influence on a more undercover level. it is concerning however, that that hippo has a star core. Depending on what he does with it, we might need to exterminate his life. . .

title: The Hermit: Part 2 (Session 4)
text:
Document by Jack Lemon, based on the purchased field reports of anomaly Alice

We might have a problem on our hands, my lord. 

Our 'reliable' asset Maxeridius turned out to be a double-agent, blackmailed by Nox Volcron to spy on Alice. But that corporate betrayal is a joke compared to the absolute nightmare that unfolded next. The Wonderless Timing party met with Lady Rayna, who told them of a hidden library behind the archives. She found a map proving King Hemmeth I's castle isn't a dungeon—it is a subterranean grid spreading like vines under the entire region, maybe country. Graveseal Station is sitting right under Red Tail. Marrow Station is under Peregrine. It's all connected.

But here is the horror. We didn't know. Nobody knew. The Mothman wasn't a freak occurrence some 200 years ago; it was a dormant experiment engineered by Norex Volcron and Skarn Graveseal. They used Hemmeth's prisoners as livestock to feed it, realizing its maze emitted a frequency that accelerated human logic. But the cosmic joke is on us: the more knowledge the scholars uncovered over the last 200 years, the more powerful the entity became. They were literally feeding the beast with their minds.

And Headmaster Harley Seer? It was him the whole time. He was a human projection of the Mothman, lure-baiting the party down to drop the final lore reveals needed to shatter his cell. It happened when Julia read 'LUX INFERNO'—a terrifying biblical prophecy from The Scorched Lord swearing to turn the world to ash just to 'shelter' it from a Frozen Doom. That final reveal drop blew the seals. Harley shed his skin, manifested his true winged form, and demanded a meal. Maxeridius tried to attack Julia, but the Mothman smashed him against the wall and literally drained his mind. Maxeridius is a vegetable. Brain-dead. 

The entity then threw them a single, vague sliver of info—confirming the ancient Exochons feared the exact same things the patrons fear. And then the situation went completely off the rails. 

Hather hijacked Alice’s body and tried to offer JK as a replacement meal, claiming JK is a reality-censoring anomaly. What happened next makes no biological sense. The moment JK tried to reveal... something, his throat locked and he suffered a spontaneous, near-fatal heart attack. 

And then, the room glitched. A cross-planar tie-breaking vote was cast to keep him alive. Cast by who? A spectator. An unmapped entity from another plane that was always there but never was. The exact meta-spectator JK always babbles about. JK was stabilized via Spare the Dying, and the crew fled with two comatose bodies and a massive ideological argument brewing between Alice and Julia.

I am concerned of whatever JK is. He is a massive, systemic infection inside the Wonderless Timing Guild. If he speaks again, the whole simulation might collapse. We need a cleaner. I am preposing maximum clearance to deploy Mr. Pineberry to Eagle's Hope County immediately to eliminate this anomaly before it kills us all.

This is the end of the December tracking log.

end report
